issue.title: Transition class is sometimes not being removed correctly when using v-show

repository.name: core
repository.description: 🖖 Vue.js is a progressive, incrementally-adoptable JavaScript framework for building UI on the web.

issue.body:
### Version
3.2.31

### Reproduction link
[sfc.vuejs.org/](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)







### Steps to reproduce
Open the SFC Playground link and click on the "Activate" button.

### What is expected?
Both the `v-if`and the `v-show` div containers should be displayed after clicking the "Activate" button.

### What is actually happening?
Sometimes the second div container which uses `v-show` is not displayed correctly - it uses the same reactive variable as the other container which uses `v-if` but its Vue.js transition class (`fade-leave-to`) is not being removed correctly, so it stays in the leave-to state.

---
The `myArray` array which length is used to compute the visibility state of both containers is being changed rapidly multiple times in the `activate()` function. This could be other things like a WebSocket message which mutates the array in real world scenarios.

body: I have the same problem where the mutation of the property that is being used for the visibility state happens through a WebSocket message.

issue.body: ### Environment **Vuetify Version:** 3.0.0-beta.1 **Vue Version:** 3.2.33 **Browsers:** Chrome 101.0.4951.54 **OS:** Windows 10 ### Steps to reproduce - Open https://codepen.io/andrewspy/pen/NWyxMPO?editors=1010 - Change `:src` by clicking "Dark" and "Light" button. - First VImg with transition does not display image accordingly. ### Expected Behavior VImg should display image accordingly after transition. ### Actual Behavior VImg does not display image accordingly after transition. ### Reproduction Link https://codepen.io/andrewspy/pen/NWyxMPO?editors=1010 ### Other comments Setting `:transition="false"` will work as expected.
